**Vehicle:** make, model, model year, battery size

**Adapter:** e.g. OBDLink MX+, ENET cable, CAN interface

**Values read off the car:** state of charge, odometer, range, SoH if known

**Report:** attach `evsoc-probe-….json` or `evsoc-wecktest-….json`

**What is right, what is wrong?**
